dave_web_interface.description: Dave's programmatic interface to the web via headless Chromium. Renders real websites in a full browser engine, captures screenshots, extracts content, and stores findings in MySQL for reasoning and change detection.
capabilities: Load any URL in headless Chromium (full JavaScript execution, CSS rendering)
Capture 1920x1080 PNG screenshot of rendered page
Extract full DOM text (what Chrome renders after JS execution)
Extract page title and meta description
Extract all HTTP/HTTPS links from the page
Store findings in MySQL (dave_kb.web_findings) for later analysis
Periodic monitoring of configured URLs with change detection
Content hash comparison to detect when pages change
Visual hash comparison to detect layout/design changes
Query historical findings by search term

chrome_configuration.javascript: enabled (full JS execution for SPA rendering)

monitoring.change_detection: SHA-256 of text content + visual screenshot hash
monitoring.notification: Posts to chat:system-health on change detection

learning_from_web: Dave fetches a URL → reads extracted text → forms understanding
Dave looks at the screenshot → understands visual layout and design
Dave tracks changes over time → understands project evolution
Dave queries his stored findings → recalls previous observations

example_workflow.trigger: Dave's monitoring cycle detects Java Web Server repo changed
example_workflow.step_2: Dave reads extracted text, compares to previous content_hash
example_workflow.step_3: Dave identifies what changed (new files, modified README, etc.)
example_workflow.step_5: Dave posts to system-health: '[DAVE] Java Web Server updated — new commit detected'
example_workflow.step_6: Dave updates his learning_log with new understanding

admin_request_workflow.trigger: Admin sends: chat send dave 'check what news.ycombinator.com looks like today'
admin_request_workflow.step_2: Dave reviews screenshot and extracted text
admin_request_workflow.step_3: Dave summarizes top stories and visual state
admin_request_workflow.step_4: Dave responds via chat with findings
admin_request_workflow.step_5: Finding stored in MySQL for historical record

security.no_credentials: Chrome stores no login sessions or cookies between runs
security.isolation: Runs as dave user, chrome-data owned mode 700
security.no_inbound: Dave does not listen on any port — initiates only
security.url_validation: Only http:// and https:// URLs accepted
security.rate_limiting: 5-second delay between fetches in monitor daemon

integration.chat: Posts observations about web changes to admin-alerts and system-health groups
integration.mysql: All findings stored in dave_kb.web_findings, queryable by any Dave process
integration.observations: Web findings can trigger entries in dave_kb.observations
integration.learning: Page content feeds Dave's learning disposition (encounter → comprehend → integrate)
integration.voting: Web-derived information passes through Dave's 5-voter system before action
